title: Add MCP proposal workflow tools
description:
Problem: proposals are a first-class MemorySmith surface (`/proposals`, maintenance proposal workflow, chat write proposal routing), but the MCP contract does not expose proposal list/get/approve/reject operations. External MCP clients therefore cannot participate cleanly in the same governance loop and must fall back to handwritten notes or UI-specific steps.

Desired outcome: expose a bounded, policy-aware MCP proposal surface for proposal discovery and human-governed action workflows.

Scope:
- In scope: design and implement MCP tools such as `memorysmith_proposal_list`, `memorysmith_proposal_get`, `memorysmith_proposal_approve`, and `memorysmith_proposal_reject` or equivalent naming.
- In scope: align tool permissions with existing proposal workflow roles and preserve audit/history behavior.
- In scope: update docs/prompts/tests for the new proposal tools.
- Out of scope: redesigning the underlying maintenance proposal schema or approval model beyond MCP exposure needs.

Validation:
- Focused MCP workflow tests for proposal listing, detail retrieval, and gated actions.
- Docs/prompts updated to reflect the supported proposal tool surface.

Confidence target: 88%.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from MCP surface review because `/proposals` is a first-class workflow but the external MCP catalog has no proposal list/get/action tools.
